title: People react to how Eric speaks to them
caption: Mio, Kenji, Kuro and Rei now sometimes comment when Eric is too casual, too stiff or just right with them, after a word from the Say menu. Each of them does this at most once a day, and the first time is noted in People.

sections.title: Kenji, too stiff
sections.caption: Day 2, B2. Eric says ohayō gozaimasu to Kenji, and Kenji is flustered that his senpai is so polite.

sections.title: Kuro, too casual
sections.caption: Day 2, reception. Eric says matte to Kuro, so she makes him wait and tells him to start with sumimasen.

sections.title: Rei, too casual
sections.caption: Day 3, the tennis courts. Eric says akete to Rei and she tells him off.
